subject: Mathematics

show.line: New babies in spring! Count the chicks. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!

rounds.prompt: Count the lambs in the field.
Count the ducklings. Say the number.
How many eggs in the nest?
Seven, eight, nine. What comes next?
Draw nine with your finger. A ball at the top, then a line down.

hints: Touch each one as you count.
Count slowly. Do not skip any.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the chicks.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven chicks!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I counted one chick twice. There are ten.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together, one at a time. All the way to ten!
